items.title: Unit 3 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
Let's put on suncream. First, my arms. Point to your arms. These are my arms.

Now, my nose. This is my nose. That's right.

Here's the suncream. Put it on your arms, your nose, your face and your legs. OK, Rosy.

Look, Rosy! Oh no!
